By passing the `fields` query parameter, only the three requested fields are returned in the layout section (no page-layout fields are pulled in), while other lightweight sections such as `objectInfo` and `recordInfo` are still included.

| Field | FLS-blocked behaviour | How achieved |

public with sharing class ContactEmailMatcher {
    public class Request {
        @InvocableVariable(required=true)
        public String email;
    }

    public class Result {
        @InvocableVariable
        public Id contactId;
    }

    @InvocableMethod(label='Match Contact by Email' description='Find a Contact by email (case-insensitive, trimmed)')
    public static List<Result> match(List<Request> requests) {
        // Collect normalized (trimmed, lower-cased) non-blank emails.
        Set<String> emails = new Set<String>();
        for (Request r : requests) {
            if (r != null && r.email != null && r.email.trim().length() > 0) {
                emails.add(r.email.trim().toLowerCase());
            }
        }

        // One SOQL query total (when there is something to look up).
        Map<String, Id> emailToContactId = new Map<String, Id>();
        if (!emails.isEmpty()) {
            List<Contact> contacts = [
                SELECT Id, Email
                FROM Contact
                WHERE Email IN :emails
                ORDER BY CreatedDate ASC, Id ASC
            ];
            // First winner per normalized email wins because of the sort above.
            for (Contact c : contacts) {
                if (c.Email == null) continue;
                String key = c.Email.trim().toLowerCase();
                if (emailToContactId.containsKey(key)) continue;
                emailToContactId.put(key, c.Id);
            }
        }

        // Exactly one Result per Request, same order.
        List<Result> results = new List<Result>();
        for (Request r : requests) {
            Result res = new Result();
            if (r != null && r.email != null && r.email.trim().length() > 0) {
                res.contactId = emailToContactId.get(r.email.trim().toLowerCase());
            }
            results.add(res);
        }
        return results;
    }
}
